page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Main text in one column on the left. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside "Scythae in Americam veniunt." and beside "Innumeros habuêre regulos." Faint show-through from the reverse page in the background, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Romanis Chartagine navigationes in Atlantico mari negligerentur.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
main_text.p: Factum fuisse ante multa jam Secula maximam Scytharum per Se-ptentrionem, aliasq; vias, quà terrâ, quà mari, quà glacie in Americam transmigrationem, & eorum multi-tudine universum illum Orbem im-pletum, multis argumentis ostendi poteft.
Singuli propè pagi linguis ac Du-cibus distincti fuerunt, quos Saga-mos seu Casiquas appellarunt, de

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is faint in the background and was left out. Doubtful readings: "Periodus II." (the mark after II may be a comma), "distincti" (the ligature is partly obscured), "aliasq;" (the mark after q is read as a semicolon), "Can. I." (the numeral may be a figure 1). The note beside "Innumeros" is read as "guber-nata in-numeris regulis", with the last word joined without a printed hyphen.
